hero.title: Project
hero.description: It took care of me, now I take care of it. I tinker, upgrade, and maintain the car. I've been making memories with it since 2011.

timeline.title: MOST-fiber audio retrofit
timeline.summary: Upgrading my car's base audio system to a 13-speaker, 480 W setup.
workNotes: Installed the amplifier and speaker system using the MOST fiber connection.
Made 3D-printed door brackets and trimmed panels to fit the speakers.
Worked from BMW wiring schematics for pinouts, cable routing, and power distribution.

photos.caption: Audio retrofit and installation work on my car.

timeline.title: Interior lighting
timeline.summary: Adding lighting behind the trim, door cards, and seats.
workNotes: Removed interior panels to install RGB lighting controllers.
Routed wiring for the under-seat, door-card, and trim lighting.
Kept connections fused and accessible for future maintenance.

timeline.title: Anti-theft retrofit
timeline.summary: Integrating OEM anti-theft hardware with the car's wiring.
workNotes: Researched the BMW wiring documentation and required connections.
Installed OEM anti-theft hardware and wiring harnesses.
Checked power and signaling after installation.

timeline.title: Repairs and mechanical work
timeline.summary: Getting hands-on with the brakes, suspension, and routine maintenance.
workNotes: Replaced brake calipers, rear shocks, engine components, and filters.
Retrofitted headlight assemblies and adjusted their alignment.
Kept records of the work performed on the car.

photos.alt: Mechanical maintenance work on my car
photos.caption: Mechanical repair and maintenance work.
